item.title: SLIPKNOT Launches Cryptic Website With Countdown, Hints At 25th Anniversary Album Reissue
item.description: Slipknot is building anticipation with a cryptic online campaign that points toward a special 25th anniversary edition of their self-titled 1999 debut album. The band has launched a mysterious new website, 742617000027.

item.title: JAMES HETFIELD Hated The Direction Metallica Took In The ‘90s: 'So Stupid'
item.description: In a 2001 interview with Playboy, Metallica frontman James Hetfield reflected on the band’s major style shift during the Load era. For Hetfield, that period, complete with designer clothes, makeup, and fashionable haircuts, wasn’t exactly a high point.

item.title: Ex-Pantera TERRY GLAZE On DIMEBAG's Death: 'It Didn't Hit Me Until I Saw The Dirt'
item.description: Former Pantera vocalist Terry Glaze has shared a personal account of how he learned about the death of guitarist “Dimebag” Darrell Abbott and the emotional aftermath that followed.

item.title: Cult Metal Band SACRED BLADE Reunites for Live Show and Album Reissue; “This is long overdue!” says Robertson
item.description: SACRED BLADE, a name spoken in hushed tones in Canadian metal lore, is back. After 20 years of silence, the Vancouver legends are set to play again—kicking things off at Germany’s Keep It True festival on April 25, 2025.
